Toddler meals

Coconut porridge

Kókuszos zabkása

6 months+ Sound idea 15 min 2 portions

Offer it from a bowl with a spoon. Do not put coconut milk in a bottle.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 40 g Rolled oats (Ordinary or fine)
  • 100 ml Unsweetened coconut milk (Plain coconut milk from a carton or can)
  • 100 ml Water (To dilute the coconut milk)
  • 80 g Ripe banana or mango (Mashed)

Allergens

gluten

Method

  1. Stir the coconut milk and water together in a small pan.
  2. Add the oats and simmer until soft.
  3. Stir in the mashed banana or mango.
  4. Cool to serving temperature.
  5. Serve in a bowl.

Sound idea

This is a bowl of porridge, not a coconut drink in a bottle. Sweetened coconut milk would add sugar.

Cook the oats in unsweetened coconut milk diluted with water, then stir in ripe banana or mango.
